hook.title:
Countdown to your trip
on your Home Screen
hook.subtitle: In 15 seconds 👇

scenes.voice: Want a countdown to your next trip on your Home Screen? Here's how.

scenes.caption: Tap New ticket
scenes.voice: Open Tixday and tap New ticket.

scenes.caption: Name it, pick the date
scenes.voice: Name it and pick the date. It turns into a ticket right away.

scenes.caption: Bonus: add the widget
scenes.voice: Bonus: add the Tixday widget, and see it every time you unlock.

closing.title: Tixday
closing.subtitle:
Search on the App Store:
“Tixday: Countdown Widgets”
closing.voice: Search Tixday Countdown Widgets on the App Store.
